queries_run: NetApp market share gaining OR losing 2026
NetApp new entrant OR displace threat enterprise storage 2026
NetApp vs storage peers market share trend 2025 2026 IDC

findings.claim: IDC：NetApp 2025 全年外接式企業儲存份額 8.1%、排第三，全快閃陣列表現穩健；外部 OEM 儲存市場 2025 年成長 4.3% 至 353 億美元
findings.source: Blocks & Files, IDC ranks Dell, NetApp, Everpure, Huawei and HPE in external storage systems market
findings.excerpt: NetApp held third place with an 8.1% share in 2025, driven by solid results in all-flash arrays. The external OEM enterprise storage systems market grew by 4.3% in 2025 to $35.3 billion.

findings.claim: IDC：2026 年第一季 NetApp 為外接式儲存第二大供應商，僅次於 Dell；前五為 Dell、NetApp、Everpure、Huawei、HPE
findings.source: Blocks & Files, IDC ranks Dell, NetApp, Everpure, Huawei and HPE in external storage systems market
findings.excerpt: NetApp was the second-largest external storage systems supplier in the first quarter of 2026, after Dell, with a top five ranking also including Everpure, Huawei, and HPE.

findings.claim: IDC 最新追蹤（2026 Q2）：NetApp 年增 35.7%、成長速度第三快，市占仍高於 Everpure
findings.source: Blocks & Files, IDC's latest enterprise storage tracker shows booming storage market growth
findings.excerpt: NetApp grew third-fastest at 35.7% year-over-year, while NetApp remained ahead of Everpure in market share trends.

findings.claim: IDC 2025 Q3：NetApp 份額 9.4% 排第三（全快閃陣列表現穩）；同期 Pure（現 Everpure）與 Huawei 為成長最快者，NetApp 非成長最快
findings.source: Blocks & Files / StorageNewsletter, IDC Q3 2025 tracker
findings.excerpt: NetApp finished third with 9.4% share thanks to solid performance in all-flash arrays (AFA).

findings.claim: NetApp 財報風險揭露：對手含既有公開公司、專注快閃的新公開公司，以及鎖定 AI 商機的新進入者
findings.excerpt: NetApp faces competition from many companies, including established public companies, newer public companies focused on flash storage, and new market entrants targeting the AI opportunity.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要稱：受供給限制的超大規模雲業者更願意認證新供應商，可能替新進入者打開取代缺口（摘要為搜尋工具轉述，未讀原頁）
findings.source: search summary on NetApp Q3 FY2026 (Futurum / Forbes results)
findings.excerpt: hyperscalers facing supply constraints are more willing to qualify new vendors, potentially opening the door to competitive displacement.
